Configuring Advanced Dynamic Workflow (ADW)
SC -3302 - S2 P Workflow
S2 P Configuration for Solutions Consultants

What is Advanced Dynamic Workflow? ADW is the newe st form of JAGGAER S2P Workflow, and is the most commonly used because it allows for maximum flexibility for clients. They can set up complex rules and continually manage approvers.

ADW C onfiguration Below is the s yntax for a ADW Rule Group reference in the workflow definitions file . The rule must reference that Rule Group and the attribute must be included to route the document correctly. Note, that the attribute is not required if you are using the Rule Group solely to evaluate the document, but not route it dynamic ally. For instance, you can have a large number of rules in ADW for evaluation purposes, but still route the document to a single shared folder. This can accommodate a requirement in rare instances where there is a single group of approvers for many rules. See below for more info on this setup.
Document.RequiresRuleGroupEvaluation("Specialty Department Approval") == true
<FolderSelectionRule>MultiElementDynamic</FolderSelectionRule> <Attribute name="RuleGroupInternalName"> <AttrValue lang="default">Specialt y Department Approval</AttrValue> </Attribute>

ADW with shared folder As stated above, you can use ADW as an evaluation tool yet send the document to a shared folder. To do this, include the ADW Rule Group reference in the rule, but not the attribute segm ent in the activity. Also, remove the MultiElementDynamic folder selection rule and add a <FolderRef> element into the activity that references the static folder.

<Activity name="Sample Activity"> <ActivityType>manual</ActivityType> <StepRef name="Sample S tep" /> <FolderRef name="Shared Folder" /> <Rule><![CDATA[Document.RequiresRuleGroupEvaluation("Department Approval") == true]]></Rule> </Activity>

ADW Product Definitions
• Contract non -catalog item – non-catalog item added to a contract
• Form item – any form, including non -catalog form
• Inventory item – inventory item
• Non catalog item – non -catalog items only
• Punch -out product – punch -out item
• Hosted catalog item – hosted catalog item
Much more information about ADW can be found in the online searchable help!
